_note: Research file (not read by pages, except points and source link on the practice-set page): the structure of the exams our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-a1…c2 = DELF A1…B2 and DALF C1…C2 (goethe-a1 and goethe-c2 have no set in this file's sense: A1 lives in the start-deutsch-1 slot, C2 has no practice set), telc-a2…c1 = our own TCF-style band sets (the TCF itself is one multilevel sitting with a 0–699 scale, not band papers): their modules and item counts are the shape the sets keep from the Spanish course's band sets, not the structure of the TCF (cleanup, 2026-11-14). The testdaf slot has its own shape and is described in testdaf-formate.json. Only structure is described; no exam task or text is copied. Field conventions: minutes = paper time; items = scored items in OUR set, modelled on the best public information we found; plays = how often the recording is heard; points = marks where known. Every DELF/DALF fact here is 'to verify': see `unverified` in each entry and reports/exams-delf-dalf.md. The telc entries describe our sets only; TCF facts are in reports/exams-tcf-tef.md, all 'to verify'.
